items.q: What does Cuban call the base skill for any career?
items.a: **Selling**: if you can sell, you can **do anything**.

items.q: Why do people who go looking for a business idea often fail?
items.a: You should find **something you love**, **get great at it**, then turn it into a business.

items.q: What does Cuban do about his weaknesses?
items.a: He admits he's **awful at details and hiring** and finds **complementary partners**.
With new tech the creator knows it best and **everyone else is tied for second**: be **second by yourself**.

items.q: How did Cuban get ahead with Lotus 1-2-3?
items.a: He **read the manuals overnight** to learn it faster than anyone.

items.q: How does Cuban use AI agents?
items.a: For **tedious work**, which freed time to read his first non-fiction book **in 25 years**.

items.q: Why does Cuban say AI is not smart?
items.a: It **doesn't know the consequences** of its actions and relies on **brute-force compute**.

items.q: Why does Cuban think AI is in a bubble?
items.a: Companies **borrow more than they make** for compute, risking a **debt bubble**.
